title: Gold Account: Mobile banking and deposit limits
summary: This document covers the Gold Account’s mobile check deposit limit ($10,000 per day) and mobile transfer-out limit ($25,000 per day). It also provides tips: endorse checks clearly, capture images in good lighting, keep the original until the deposit shows as completed, and check remaining daily capacity (then wait until the next day if limits near $10,000/$25,000).
